note: Three rewordings of each triage question. Criteria keys stay the same so answers can be compared; only the wording changes.

team.instructions: Which team at Contoso is responsible for fixing this?

criteria.auth: Login, MFA, SSO, API keys and permissions
criteria.infra: Platform reliability: outages, errors, performance, webhooks
criteria.data: Reports, exports, imports and data correctness
criteria.account: Plans, seats, settings and account ownership

team.instructions: Route this support ticket to the right owner.

criteria.payments: Money: checkout, cards, invoices, subscription charges
criteria.infra: Uptime and performance of the service
criteria.data: Data quality, reporting and data movement

team.instructions: If you had to give this ticket to one team to start the fix, which team would it be?

criteria.payments: The team that runs billing and payment processing
criteria.auth: The team that runs sign-in and access control
criteria.infra: The team that keeps the platform running
criteria.data: The team that owns reporting, exports and sync
criteria.account: The team that manages plans, seats and account settings

urgency.instructions: How quickly does someone need to act on this ticket?
Rate the urgency. Critical means many people are down or data or security is at risk right now.
What priority should this ticket get in the support queue?

customer_blocked.instructions: Is the customer stuck with no way to continue?
Does this problem stop the customer's work completely?

criteria.false: No, they can carry on or are just asking

customer_blocked.instructions: Does the customer have a workaround or can they keep working?

criteria.true: No workaround; they cannot keep working
criteria.false: They have a workaround or can keep working

contains_personal_data.instructions: Is there any personally identifiable information in this ticket?

criteria.true: Yes: emails, phone numbers, card digits, addresses or full names

contains_personal_data.instructions: Would this ticket need redacting before it is shared outside support?

criteria.true: Yes, it includes a person's contact or payment details or full name

contains_personal_data.instructions: Does the message include contact details, payment details or the full name of a person?
